snippet.title: Prince of Persia 3: Kindred Blades - Beta Two Thrones Trailer [High Quality]
snippet.description:
GC trailer of Prince of Persia 3: Kindred Blades, the beta version of Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones, released in 2005 for Playstation 2, Xbox, GameCube and PC.

Source: Cube Magazine 49 bonus disc
